The '''1935–36 [[Super League Greece|Panhellenic Championship]]''' was the seventh season of the highest [[Association football|football]] league of Greece.

It was held as a national category, in which 8 (out of 10) teams from the 3 founding Associations of the [[Hellenic Football Federation|HFF]], ''that had participated in the 2 groups of the [[1934–35 Panhellenic Championship#Semi-final round|previous season's semi-final round]]'' and resulted as follows:
*'''[[Athens Football Clubs Association|Athenian]] Championship''': The first 3 Athenian teams of the ranking in the [[1934–35 Panhellenic Championship#South Group|1934–35 South Group]].
*'''[[Piraeus Football Clubs Association|Piraeus']] Championship''': The 2 Piraeus' teams of the [[1934–35 Panhellenic Championship#South Group|1934–35 South Group]].
*'''[[Macedonia Football Clubs Association|Macedonian]] Championship''': The first 3 Macedonian teams of the ranking in the [[1934–35 Panhellenic Championship#North Group|1934–35 North Group]].
 
Those teams did not participate in their regional leagues in that season. The event started on October 26, 1935 and ended on June 14, 1936. [[Olympiacos F.C.|Olympiacos]] emerged champion, having only a 4-1 defeat by [[Panathinaikos F.C.|Panathinaikos]]. The point system was: ''Win: 2 points'' - ''Draw: 1 point'' - ''Loss: 0 points''.
